description: This file defines a set of functions for interacting with TR-069 protocol operations, such as getting and setting parameters, rebooting devices, factory resetting, downloading files, and querying task status. It includes mock implementations for testing and real API calls for actual device interactions.

methods.name: tr069GetParameterValues({ deviceId, parameters })
methods.description: Fetches TR-069 parameter values from a device, returning mock data if in mock mode, otherwise making an API POST request.

methods.name: tr069SetParameterValues({ deviceId, parameters })
methods.description: Sets TR-069 parameter values on a device, returning mock success if in mock mode, otherwise making an API POST request.

methods.name: tr069GetParameterNames({ deviceId, path, nextLevel = false })
methods.description: Retrieves parameter names from a device, with mock data or actual API call based on mode.

methods.name: tr069Reboot({ deviceId })
methods.description: Reboots a device via TR-069 protocol, using mock or API call.

methods.name: tr069FactoryReset({ deviceId })
methods.description: Performs a factory reset on the device via TR-069, with mock or real API call.

methods.name: tr069Download({ deviceId, fileType, url, username, password })
methods.description: Initiates a download (such as firmware update) on the device via TR-069, either mock or API.

methods.name: tr069GetTaskStatus({ taskId })
methods.description: Checks the status of a TR-069 task, either mock or via API GET request.

ctags.name: tr069Download
ctags.pattern: /^export async function tr069Download({ deviceId, fileType, url, username, password }) {$/

ctags.name: tr069GetParameterNames
ctags.pattern: /^export async function tr069GetParameterNames({ deviceId, path, nextLevel = false }) {$/
